## ExpiresDebugOccurrence.parsed property

The result of parsing `raw` per RFC6265 section 5.1.1. `null` means the value could not be parsed as a cookie date and the attribute was ignored.

**Signature:**

```typescript
parsed: ExpiryDebugInstant | null;
```
